meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 这个技能不改变 Claude 的回答，只在你输入 /caveman-stats 时，从会话日志里读出真实的 token 用量、估算节省、规则开销和净节省，并把结果直接显示给你。模型本身不计算这些数字。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 会话中输入 /caveman-stats 命令时触发，显示统计结果。

say.note: 立刻显示当前会话的 token 用量和节省估算。

say.text: 查看这次会话的 token 统计

say.note: 会显示开销和净额，若为负会建议关闭。

howto.what_en: This skill doesn't alter Claude's replies. On /caveman-stats it reads real token usage, estimated savings, rule overhead, and net savings from the session log and displays them. The model doesn't compute these numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type the /caveman-stats command in a Claude Code session, showing the statistics.

say_en.note: Shows token usage and savings for this session.

say_en.text: Show me the token stats for this session

say_en.note: Shows overhead and net; suggests disabling if negative.
